classification.habitat: Moist and dry deciduous forests, especially in hilly tracts.
classification.distribution: Sub-Himalayan tract and the warmer parts of India, from Bihar and Assam to the Deccan and Western Ghats.

identification.description: Heart-shaped or ovoid dark shiny black drupe seated on an orange-yellow fleshy receptacle (receptacle edible), pericarp filled with corrosive black vesicating juice.
identification.whole_plant: Deciduous tree with large obovate leaves crowded at branch ends and black nuts seated on swollen orange receptacles.
identification.stem: Trunk with dark brown, rough bark exuding an acrid juice that blackens on exposure.
identification.leaf: Simple, alternate, large, obovate-oblong, 30–60 cm long, coriaceous, crowded towards the branch ends.
identification.flower: Small, greenish-yellow, in terminal panicles; polygamous.
identification.fruit: Drupe laterally flattened, obliquely ovoid, 2.5–3 cm long, smooth, shining black, seated on a fleshy orange-yellow receptacle; pericarp full of acrid black oil.
identification.seed: Single kernel, white and oily, enclosed in the hard nut.
identification.bark: Dark brown, rough, exuding an irritant juice that turns black.
identification_points: Heart-shaped or ovoid dark shiny black drupe seated on an orange-yellow fleshy receptacle (receptacle edible), pericarp filled with corrosive black vesicating juice.

useful_part: Purified Fruit pericarp / Nut (Shodhita Phala / Seed oil)
therapeutics.dose: 1–2 g of shodhita drug in kshirapaka form (API).
therapeutics.anupana: Milk (kshirapaka) and ghee; give with ample ghee and milk in the diet.
therapeutics.precautions: Must be used only after shodhana. The raw nut oil is a severe contact irritant producing blistering dermatitis; ghee or coconut is applied before handling. Avoid exposure to heat and sun during use and take a ghee- and milk-rich diet.
therapeutics.contraindications: Contraindicated in pregnancy, in children and the elderly, in Pitta-predominant persons, bleeding disorders, kidney disease and hot season; never used without shodhana.

shlokas:
भल्लातकं त्रिषु प्रोक्तमरुष्कोऽरुष्करोऽग्निकः ।
तथैवाग्निमुखी भल्ली वीरवृक्षश्च शोफकृत् ॥२००॥

भल्लातकफलं पक्वं स्वादुपाकरसं लघु ।
कषायं पाचनं स्निग्धं तीक्ष्णोष्णं चेदि भेदनम् ॥२०१॥

तन्मज्जा मधुरो वृष्यो बृंहणो वातपित्तहा ।
वृन्तमारुष्करं स्वादु पित्तघ्नं केश्यमग्निकृत् ॥२०३॥

भल्लातकः कषायोष्णः शुक्रलो मधुरो लघुः ।
वातश्लेष्मोदरानाहकुष्ठार्शोग्रहणीगदान् ।
हन्ति गुल्मज्वरश्वित्रवह्निमान्द्यकृमिव्रणान् ॥२०४॥

phytochemistry.chemical_notes: The pericarp contains a black tarry oil of phenolic lipids (anacardic acid, cardol, bhilawanol), responsible for both its action and its vesicant toxicity.

modern_information.evidence_summary: Powerful digestive and stimulant, used under medical supervision for vata disorders.
modern_information.safety_notes: Raw nut juice causes severe contact dermatitis and blistering; internal use is restricted to purified drug in small doses under supervision.
